rows.answer:
To calculate the return on own funds (ROOF), we need to determine the net income and the total investment. The net income is given as 20,590 € per year. The total investment is 431,000 €.

First, we calculate the annual return on own funds by dividing the net income by the total investment:

$$
\text{Return on Own Funds} = \frac{20,590}{431,000} \times 100
$$

$$
\text{Return on Own Funds} = 0.0475 \times 100
$$

$$
\text{Return on Own Funds} = 4.75\%
$$

<answer>4.75</answer>
